text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Wednesday held a meeting with Public Health Minister Hedi Mhenni on the health sector. Life expectancy is over 71 years in Tunisia.
- Tunisia and Spain signed a protocol to boost trade exchanges and partnership between the two countries.
- Environment Minister Mohamed Mehdi Mlika was received by Finnish President Martti Ahtisaari on Wednesday. Finland ready to reinforce environment cooperation with Tunisia.
- Tunisia and Spain signed an accord to boost bilateral cooperation in tourism sector.
- Tunisia exported four tonnes of French beans to France this week.
